description: One OpenAI embeddings call with two inputs, traced by OpenInference.
notes: OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. Embedding vectors are recorded by default as embedding.embeddings.N.embedding.vector (eight doubles each) and again inside output.value, so this capture lets B1 check that they do not remain in attributes. Prompt tokens 6 are copied from prompt_tokens. The span kind is EMBEDDING and the model is embedding.model_name.
